output.question: Has Humana announced layoffs?
output.answer: Humana has confirmed some job cuts, but it has not announced a sized layoff. On Oct. 26, 2026, WDRB/WAVE reported that the Louisville-based insurer is cutting jobs as part of a companywide reorganization. Humana would not say how many workers or which departments are affected. Its spokesperson said 'some roles are eliminated while new roles and opportunities are created in areas that support our future direction.' A LinkedIn post cited by Louisville Business First said copywriter and content creator roles were eliminated. A third-party WARN tracker shows no Humana WARN filings in 2026, so no formal mass-layoff notice appears to have been filed.

key_facts.fact: Humana is cutting jobs in Louisville as part of a companywide reorganization. It would not say how many workers were affected or which departments were hit.
Humana's director of corporate communications, Mark Taylor, said some roles are being eliminated while new roles are created, and that Humana keeps a large Louisville workforce.
A LinkedIn post cited by Louisville Business First said copywriter and content creator roles were eliminated. The cuts followed several recent changes to Humana's executive leadership.
The Layoff Club's WARN tracker shows no Humana WARN filings since the start of 2025, including none in 2026.
On a mid-2026 earnings call, Humana described outsourcing in finance and HR, IT vendor optimization, and moving utilization management from 11 markets into a single team. No role count was given.

passages.quote: wouldn't say how many workers were impacted or which departments were hit
some roles are eliminated while new roles and opportunities are created in areas that support our future direction
Humana continues to maintain a large employee base in Louisville, and we remain committed to our hometown community
utilization management had been centralized from 11 markets into a single team

caveats: Humana has not disclosed how many people are affected, which departments, or the timeline, so the size of the cuts is unknown.
Humana's statement comes second-hand: WDRB quotes what the company told Louisville Business First. I found no Humana press release or SEC filing about these cuts.
Search results say Becker's Payer also reported the cuts around Oct. 27, 2026, and noted no recent Kentucky WARN notices. The page returned an error (403), so I could not check it and did not use it.
The 'no WARN filings' finding comes from a third-party tracker, not a state agency. WARN covers only qualifying mass layoffs, so having no filing does not rule out cuts.
Anonymous employee forum posts (TheLayoff.com, Indeed reviews) are anecdotal and were not used.
